layers.file: File:XC707075 - European Herring Gull - Larus argentatus.mp3

species: European herring gull (Larus argentatus) giving its loud, laughing 'kyow-kyow' call in flight on the Normandy coast near Mont-Saint-Michel, France (Xeno-canto XC707075)
note: The default 70 Hz high-pass is kept because the recording has surf and wind rumble below 80 Hz (about −19 dB relative to the calls).
